function getCookieInCommonSystem(cName){
	var cookieVal = "";
    if(document.cookie.indexOf(cName) != -1){
        document.cookie.split(";").forEach((arg)=>{
            if(arg.indexOf(cName) != -1) cookieVal = arg.trim().replaceAll(cName+"=","");
        });
    }
	return cookieVal;
}
	
async function showAlerts(alerts){
	for (const alert of alerts){
		const result = await Swal.fire({
			icon: alert.icon,
			title: alert.title,
			html: alert.html,
			showCancelButton:alert.showCancelButton,
			confirmButtonColor:'#572b4c',
			cancelButtonColor:'#666',
			cancelButtonText:alert.cancelButtonText,
			confirmButtonText:alert.confirmButtonText,
			allowOutsideClick:false,
			customClass:alert.customClass
		});
		
		if(result.isConfirmed && alert.onConfirm){
			alert.onConfirm();
		}
		
		if(result.isDismissed && alert.onCancel){
			alert.onCancel();
		}
	}	
}
